Subject: Invitation to Speak at the Future of Tech Conference

Dear [Speaker Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to you on behalf of the organizing committee for the upcoming Future of Tech Conference, scheduled to take place on [Date] in [Location]. This year’s theme is "Innovation in the Age of AI," and we are looking for visionary leaders to share their insights with our audience of industry professionals and academics.

Given your extensive work in [Speaker's Specific Field/Topic], we believe you would be an exceptional fit for our keynote slot. Your recent publication on [Specific Topic] resonated deeply with our team, and we think your perspective would greatly enrich the conversation around ethical AI development.

We would be honored to have you join us as a keynote speaker. In terms of engagement, we are offering a speaking fee of $[Amount], along with coverage of all travel and accommodation expenses. We anticipate your session to last approximately 45 minutes, followed by a 15-minute Q&A.

Please let us know if you are available and interested in this opportunity. We would be happy to schedule a brief call to discuss the details further.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
Conference Organizer
[Your Contact Information]

***

A book is primarily made of paper.
